summary: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Board of Directors declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on its common shares, payable November 10, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 30, 2026. No advisor, premium, or structural mechanics were disclosed, and the filing carries no transaction or event-driven implication. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration rather than a special situation; there is no deal, stake, or regulatory clock to monitor, and no risk-arb angle applies.
